text: Alternatively, research by Bickel and colleagues (10) indicates that elderly people need a greater weekly minimum training dose to maintain muscle once they have achieved a given level of hypertrophy from resistance training. Seventy young (20 to 35 years of age) and old (60 to 75 years of age) participants performed a 3-day-per-week resistance training program for 16 weeks. Following training, the subjects were randomly assigned to a detraining protocol involving no exercise, a maintenance protocol that was 1/3 that of the original program, or a maintenance protocol that was 1/9 that of the original.
